description: This PHP source file defines the class 'FormatWithJobTitle', which implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface. It formats entity values into job title names by utilizing the 'JobTitleService' to retrieve 'JobTitle' entities based on an entity ID.

classes.name: FormatWithJobTitle
classes.description: A class that formats entity values into specific job title names using the 'JobTitleService'. Implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to provide a formatted string representation.
